name: OSS_USAGE_EVENT_TYPES
description: Following table is used to capture usage event type.

columns.name: EVENT_TYPE_ID
columns.description: Unique key identifier to capture usage event type.

columns.name: EVENT_TYPE
columns.description: Alternate identifier of usage event type.

columns.name: NAME
columns.description: Field used to capture name of usage event type.

columns.name: DESCRIPTION
columns.description: Field used to capture description of usage event type.

columns.name: PRICE_LIST_ID
columns.description: To uniquely identify and associate a set of pricing details with a particular group of products, services, or customer segments.

columns.name: PRICE_UOM
columns.description: To indicate the unit of measurement for which the listed price applies, such as per piece, per MB, per volume, etc.

columns.name: INVENTORY_ITEM_ID
columns.description: Inventory item id of subscription item.

columns.name: RATE_PLAN_ID
columns.description: To uniquely identify and associate a specific rate plan with a customer, service, or product. Rate plans often define the pricing structure, terms, and conditions for the use of a product or service.

columns.name: STATUS
columns.description: Field used to capture status of usage event type.

columns.name: SOURCE_TYPE
columns.description: Field used to capture source type of usage event type.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
